Body.Content: The Azure Marketplace (formerly Azure Store/Azure Gallery) is a unified applications and services ecosystem for Azure customers and partners. Within a single, unified platform, you can discover, evaluate, and purchase infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) and platform-as-a-service (PaaS) solutions that enhance Azure cloud services. Expanding on the existing portfolio of application and data services, the Marketplace enables you to purchase single and multi-node virtual machine images from industry leaders, such as Cloudera, DataStax, Veeam, Trend Micro, Kaspersky Lab, NGINX, and CoreOS. This gives you new deployment choices and scalable infrastructure offerings to run your small and large workloads on the Azure platform. For more information, please visit the Marketplace page or access the Marketplace in the existing Azure Management Portal and Azure Preview portal.
Body.Markdown:
The Azure Marketplace (formerly Azure Store/Azure Gallery) is a unified applications and services ecosystem for Azure customers and partners. Within a single, unified platform, you can discover, evaluate, and purchase infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) and platform-as-a-service (PaaS) solutions that enhance Azure cloud services. Expanding on the existing portfolio of application and data services, the Marketplace enables you to purchase single and multi-node virtual machine images from industry leaders, such as Cloudera, DataStax, Veeam, Trend Micro, Kaspersky Lab, NGINX, and CoreOS. This gives you new deployment choices and scalable infrastructure offerings to run your small and large workloads on the Azure platform.

For more information, please visit the Marketplace page or access the Marketplace in the existing Azure Management Portal and Azure Preview portal .
